title: Turkish Kısır Bulgur Salad with Red Pepper Paste
summary: Fine bulgur is tossed with a sweet-sharp pepper paste, juicy tomato and fresh herbs for a vibrant, tangy salad scooped up with crisp lettuce leaves.

ingredients.item: red peppers, deseeded and cut into large pieces
fine sea salt or table salt
crisp romaine lettuce leaves, to serve
lemon, cut into wedges, to serve

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Shake 260 g fine bulgur in a sieve to remove dust, tip into a bowl, cover with cold water and leave to soak for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pepper Paste
steps.text: Purée the red peppers and chilli with 2 tbsp water, ¼ tsp of the salt and the sugar, then cook in a small saucepan on medium, stirring often, until thick and jammy, about 20 minutes; leave to cool.

steps.title: Tomatoes
steps.text: Halve the tomatoes, squeeze out the seeds and grate the cut side on the coarse holes of a box grater, discarding the skins.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Drain the bulgur well, return it to the bowl and add the pepper paste, tomato pulp, remaining salt, spring onions, cucumber, parsley, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, olive oil and paprika; mix well.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill for a couple of hours.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Taste for seasoning, then pile onto a platter edged with lettuce leaves and lemon wedges, using the leaves to scoop up the salad.

tips: Shake the bulgur free of dust before soaking so the finished salad isn't gritty.
Let the pepper paste cool before mixing it in, so it doesn't warm the salad through.
Chill for a couple of hours before serving to let the flavours settle together.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; the salad is served cold, so no reheating is needed. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
